mapper.select: select a.*,c.`NAME` as deptName, d.`NAME` as dutyName from (select '总部' as userType, ID,`NAME`,DEPT_ID,DUTY_ID,`STATUS` as status, SEX,ID_NUMBER,BIRTH,PHONE,HIRE_DATE,POSITIVE_TIME, USER_ID as userId,LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate from PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and `STATUS` = '0' union all select '分公司' as userType, ID,`NAME`,DEPT_ID,DUTY_ID,HR_STATUS as status, SEX,ID_NUMBER,BIRTH,PHONE,HIRE_DATE,POSITIVE_TIME, null as userId,RESIGNATION_TIME as leaveDate from HR_SUB_PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'and `STATUS` in ('0', '1') and HR_STATUS = '0') a LEFT JOIN SYS_ORG c ON a.DEPT_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_POSITION d ON a.DUTY_ID = d.ID
